_description: GET /api/refs/search. Query: q (string, 0..=200 chars, empty = most recent), kinds (optional comma list of active kinds, default the five kinds of the first release: plan, task, note, decision, rfc; any other kind must be asked for by name. persona, skill, file and commit are sensitive and are only suggested when project_id or workspace_slug is also given), project_id / workspace_slug (optional filters), limit (1..=50, default 20). Response 200: {items}. Each item: kind, id, label (title), subtitle (optional, one line of context), project and workspace (optional {id, slug, name}), entity_status (the entity's own status, optional). Fields that are absent are omitted, not null. Results are already filtered by the access policy. ORDER: with a non-empty q, ranked by relevance across ALL kinds (whole title > start of title > start of a word of the title > anywhere in the title > every word in the title > anywhere in the body > every word in title or body; case and accents ignored), equal relevance = most recent first, the cut to `limit` comes after the sort; with an empty q each kind is listed by recency and the kinds take turns. The order of the items in `response` below is an illustration (items and their shape are unchanged), not a promise of kind order. 400 with the refs_invalid body on a bad query (see errors.json).
